LOOK = CAT-FOLK: a cat-folk adventurer — a human-like body and stance but a CAT'S HEAD: a furry feline face with a short muzzle, whiskers, big slit-pupil eyes, and two LARGE upright triangular CAT EARS (if hooded, the ears poke out through two slits in the hood, clearly above it); a long thick furred CAT TAIL curving up behind, clear of the body; furry hands/paws gripping the weapon. The ears and tail are the tag: at 48 px both must be visible in the silhouette. Fur: cream-white fur with dark brown points on the ears, face mask and tail tip. Class brief (kit, pose, colours; ignore its hair/face/gender notes where they conflict with the LOOK): Full-body anime caster, slender, facing right in a poised upright stance: a tall gnarled staff held upright in the right hand, taller than the head, with a small bright ember-orange crystal at its tip painted as a jewel-bright flat shape (a lit crystal, NOT a glow halo, NOT a light bloom, NOT blue), long layered robes in dusty violet and ivory falling to the ankles with a wide hem, a soft hood raised over long pale hair that spills out as flowing anime locks, NO wizard hat, NO beard, the free left hand open at the hip with fingers spread. Violet + ivory + one warm ember accent so the silhouette reads 'tall staff with a bright tip, long robes, hood' at 48 px; clearly distinct from the fighter, rogue and ranger.
assets.brief3: The hero, the CASTER class. Poised upright; a tall gnarled STAFF held upright in the right hand, TALLER than the head, crowned with a pale MIST crystal painted as a flat bright jewel (no halo, no glow cloud); long layered ROBES to the ankles in DUSK and MOON washes with a wide hem; a BLOOD mantle and hood-cowl over the shoulders (hood down, face visible) flaring into a long BLOOD cloak behind; the free left hand open at the hip. TAG: the staff column + the long robe triangle. LOOK = CAT-FOLK: a human face (clear pale BONE face patch, yellow eyes) under wild dark hair with two LARGE upright triangular black CAT EARS on top of the head, and a long black CAT TAIL curling up behind, clear of the body and cloak. At game size the ears and the tail are both visible in the silhouette.

Seamless when tiled.

Flagstone floor with one BROKEN slab: two whole slabs on the left separated by a dark 1-pixel mortar line, and on the right a slab shattered into three pieces by jagged DARK cracks, with two small pale loose chips. Stone stairs going UP, seen from above: four stone steps, lit edges on each step front, the top step the lightest value, stone side walls left and right.

A WALL TORCH SCONCE, front view: an iron bracket bolted to the wall (a small dark plate with a ring) holding a short wooden torch upright, burning with a bright flame: white-yellow core, orange body, red tips, two or three flame tongues. The flame occupies the top third. Flat #0000FF background.

A wooden barrel standing upright, seen from a top-down three-quarter camera: the round lid visible on top as an ellipse, dark wooden staves, two dark iron hoops, lit on its upper-left. Flat #0000FF background.

A round clay pot / urn, three-quarter top-down view: dark opening at the top, round belly, a band of simple pattern, terracotta brown, lit upper-left. Flat #0000FF background.

A heraldic WALL BANNER hanging straight down from a short dark iron rod: a WIDE crimson cloth rectangle (the cloth is at least 60% as wide as it is tall) with a bold bone-white SIGIL in its middle (a simple upright sword crossed by a short bar, 2 pixels thick), a gold-ochre trim line along the top, and a torn SWALLOWTAIL bottom edge (a V notch). Dark folds on the right side. The previous attempt was a thin red stick with no sigil. Flat #0000FF background.

Lit top rail, shaded bottom. 1-pixel dark outline. Flat #0000FF background.

Lit top rail, shaded bottom. 1-pixel dark outline. Flat #0000FF background.

A beast's NEST / den mound on the floor, three-quarter top-down view: a low WIDE dome of heaped straw and twigs (fills the tile width, about 10 pixels tall), lit straw on top and upper-left, darker at the base, with a clearly DARK, nearly BLACK round burrow HOLE in the front centre (about 6x4 pixels, the darkest area of the sprite, surrounded by lighter straw), and two small pale bone chips stuck in the straw on the left. 1-pixel dark outline. Fills about 60% of the tile, centred. Flat #0000FF background.
